_doc: The design-delta engine's config, read from the project root. Contracts live beside their components; the design side is Figma with no files yet, so `verify` runs contract-to-code only until a snapshot is gathered.

rules._doc: Severities that differ from the engine defaults. coverage/uncontracted-component is error here because CLAUDE.md invariant 2 makes the contract the source of truth: a component with no contract is never audited again, which is the drift this template exists to prevent. Pinned by test-utils/contract-coverage.test.ts.
